acquisition method: coupled to the Orbitrap Exploris 240 system, in DDA mode.
alkylation reagent: followed by in-gel alkylation using iodoacetamide (50 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM).
alkylation concentration: followed by in-gel alkylation using iodoacetamide (50 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM).
cleavage agent: this was followed by in-gel tryptic digestion with 1.5 to 2 μg trypsin (Pierce Trypsin Protease MS grade Cat no. 90059, Thermo Fisher) in 300 μl ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM) at 37 °C for 16 h.
enrichment method: we adopted the approach of immunoprecipitating lysine-methylated proteins from lysates of wild type and set mutant parasites, and identifying them by mass spectrometry.
instrument: Q Exactive Plus Orbitrap, Orbitrap Exploris 240
